g.text: Studies by intervention and country income
One dot = one study; circle area is proportional to study count. Orange dots fill from the bottom. Base: 27,897 single-country eligible studies with a
known publication-year World Bank income group. Includes reviews, matching the supplied figure. Intervention is the primary class assigned from the
abstract. L&MICs includes low-, lower-middle- and upper-middle-income settings.
